shiftLock.slot: Cap near selector base on console
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
Locate the shift lock override slot — Cap near selector base on console.
Insert a thin key or small flathead into the slot.
Press firmly and hold.
Press the brake pedal while holding.
Move the selector to Neutral.
Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to N normally.
CVT transmissions: do NOT exceed 35 mph or 50 miles with driven wheels on ground — flatbed strongly preferred.

tow.method: FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air. AWD: flatbed only. AWD without flatbed: wheel-lift with dollies on opposite axle. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION OPTION: If equipped with manual trans, no shift lock — depress clutch and select Neutral. No override slot needed.
CVT EQUIPPED: Do NOT exceed 35 mph or 50 miles with drive wheels on ground. Flatbed strongly preferred for CVTs.

alerts.notes: Manual: clutch to N. AWD available on Mazda3 (2019+).

shiftLock.slot: Cap near selector base on console
steps: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the shift lock override slot — Cap near selector base on console.
Pry off the cap or cover if present using your ignition key or a small flathead.
Insert the key (or a thin flathead) into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove key from slot and replace cap.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
If power cannot be restored, use the shift lock slot above — Cap near selector base on console.

tow.method: FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air. AWD: flatbed only. AWD without flatbed: wheel-lift with dollies on opposite axle. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.

shiftLock.slot: Cap near selector base (older) or electronic selector slot (2024+)
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
Pry or slide the trim piece at the base of the electronic gear selector to expose the override slot.
Remove trim panel or cover if present — use a trim pry tool or your fingernail at the edge.
Insert a thin key or flathead into the exposed slot.
Press firmly inward and hold.
While holding, press the brake pedal.
Press the N button or move the electronic selector to Neutral.
Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and select N normally on the electronic selector.
Electronic selectors require power — mechanical override is a last resort only.

tow.method: FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air. AWD: flatbed only. CX-90 PHEV: flatbed only. AWD without flatbed: wheel-lift with dollies on opposite axle. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: HYBRID/PHEV: Use 12V auxiliary battery ONLY for jumping. NEVER access the high-voltage battery pack.
FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.

battery.jumpPoints: Under hood — standard terminals. CX-90 PHEV: 12V only.

tow.method: Lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air or flatbed — low clearance, flatbed preferred. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: RWD: Lift from REAR. Rear (drive) wheels are lifted in the air. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.
LOW CLEARANCE VEHICLE: Use flatbed. Check ground clearance before attempting any wheel-lift — front splitter/rear diffuser damage is common.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION OPTION: If equipped with manual trans, no shift lock — depress clutch and select Neutral. No override slot needed.

battery.location: Under hood (driver side on ND gen), or passenger side on NC gen
battery.warning: Very low clearance. Soft top: never run straps over the roof.

alerts.notes: Manual transmission is most common on all generations. Manual: depress clutch fully, select Neutral — no shift lock slot needed. Automatic (rare): slot near selector base on console.

issues.title: Very Low Ground Clearance
issues.detail: Ground clearance on the Miata is approximately 4.5 inches. Use shallow approach ramps for flatbed loading. The front air dam and soft front lip are easily damaged by standard ramp angles.

issues.title: Soft Top Convertible Damage Risk
issues.detail: Soft top models are easily damaged if straps or chains contact the roof. Use hood straps or wheel lift methods. Never run straps over the soft top.

steps: MANUAL TRANSMISSION (standard on NA/NB): depress clutch fully, move lever to Neutral.
AUTOMATIC (rare, available on some NA/NB trims): locate slot near selector base on console.
Pry off cap. Insert key. Press firmly. Hold. Press brake. Move to N.
Apply parking brake.
Manual: depress clutch, select N.
Auto: connect jump pack — under hood. Once powered, shift to N.
RWD: lift from rear. High-value — flatbed preferred.

tow.method: RWD: lift from rear. Flatbed strongly preferred to avoid body damage.
notes: RWD: lift from rear.
Lightweight body — very easy to scratch. Flatbed preferred.
Manual trans: depress clutch, select Neutral — no shift lock.

alerts.notes: Manual is the most common configuration. Auto was available but rare.

shiftLock.slot: Small slot near gear selector base on center console
steps: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the shift lock release: small cap near gear selector base on center console.
Pry off cap with ignition key or small flathead.
Insert key or thin flathead and press firmly downward.
While holding, press the brake pedal firmly.
Move selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove tool and replace cap.
Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack — under hood.
Once powered, shift to N.
RWD: lift from rear.
CRITICAL: Rotary engine floods very easily — see Known Issues before attempting roadside restart.

tow.method: RWD: lift from rear. Flatbed preferred.
notes: RWD: lift from rear.
Rotary engine: very common flood tow — do not attempt restart without proper procedure.

battery.warning: Rotary engine frequently floods — this is a shop repair, not a roadside fix.

alerts.warning: Rotary engine: very prone to flooding (over-choking on cold starts). Extremely common tow call.
alerts.notes: Renesis rotary engine. Very common flood/no-start tow. Battery under hood. Manual: depress clutch.

issues.title: Rotary Engine Flooding — Extremely Common Tow Call
issues.detail: The RX-8 Renesis rotary engine is notorious for flooding (fuel-wash of apex seals) when started cold, driven short distances, or improperly shut down. This is the most common reason the RX-8 is towed. Do not attempt to 'jump start and go' — the engine requires a specific flooding recovery procedure. Tow to a shop.
